map.实际年化 6.18%、按月复利的名义利率: Effective annual 6.18%, nominal rate compounded monthly
map.：r=n×((1+EAR)^(1/n)−1)=12×((1.0618)^(1/1: : r = n x ((1+EAR)^(1/n) - 1) = 12 x ((1.0618)^(1/12) - 1) = 12 x (1.005 - 1) = 12 x 0.005 = 6.00%. That is, a nominal 6% compounded monthly gives an EAR of 6.18%.

map.为什么名义利率低于实际年化？: Why is the nominal rate lower than the effective annual rate?
map.因为复利频率放大了收益。名义 6% 按月复利后真实拿到 6.18%，名义是「挂牌: Because compounding frequency amplifies returns. A nominal 6% compounded monthly really delivers 6.18%; nominal is the "quoted basis" and EAR is the "received basis".
map.这个换算对贷款也适用吗？: Does this conversion apply to loans as well?
map.适用同一数学关系，只是语义相反：贷款的 EAR 是真实成本，名义是合同标注值，比: The same mathematical relation applies, with the meaning reversed: for a loan the EAR is the true cost and the nominal is the contractual figure, so compare costs by EAR too.
